 IU to hold two-day concert in Philippines in January 2027
 By Mark Carlo Sibug
 November 20, 2026
 10
 Resize 
 Small 
 Medium 
 Large 
 MANILA, Philippines — South Korean singer-songwriter and actress IU is set to return to the Philippines for a two-day concert in the last week of January 2027 as part of her upcoming world tour.
 IU confirmed the Philippine stop through a comment on the fan platform Berriz, revealing that she would meet Filipino fans for two days in late January.
 Details of the concert, including the exact dates, venue, ticket prices, seat plan and local promoter, have yet to be announced by her agency.
 The singer last performed in the Philippines in June 2024 as part of her "H.E.R. (HEREH) World Tour," which was held at the Philippine Arena in Bulacan.
 Earlier in July 2026, IU's planned September concert and new album were reportedly put on hold as she focused on recovering from a chronic ear condition.

 IU, whose real name is Lee Ji-eun, is known for hit songs such as "Love wins all," "Blueming," "BBIBBI" and "Celebrity."
 She has also established herself as an actress, starring in acclaimed Korean dramas such as "My Mister," "When Life Gives You Tangerines" and "Perfect Crown."
 Advertisement 
 Her upcoming two-day concert will mark her return to the Philippines more than two years after her last show, giving Filipino fans another opportunity to see the K-pop star perform live.
